results.title: Heather McMahan: By a Thread
results.overview: Everyone’s stressed. We’re all hanging on BY A THREAD. But don’t worry, we can all laugh about it together. BY A THREAD. October 16. Hulu.

results.title: Jamais Vu - Reverse Fall
results.overview: In the near future, mercenary sandmen from the Moon control Earth's gravity, rented out like electricity or water. Those unable to pay face exile into a black hole. Amid the chaos, a boy named Keyvan must find his way.

results.title: Poniiy
results.overview: A young local girl's family cares for a dog named Poniiy, whose true owner, a kind-hearted man, has mysteriously gone missing. Determined to reunite them, the girl and Poniiy set out on a heartfelt journey to find him.

results.title: How to cut your hair
results.overview: Dalia lives in a house dominated by routine and traditions. Wanting to cut her hair, she faces opposition from those around her and begins a small rebellion, cutting the frame with scissors, shattering the continuity and logic of her world.

results.title: Letters
results.overview: In the school hallway, Anita excitedly tells Chloe that she plans to confess her feelings to Antoni after school. Later, Anita goes to the garden gazebo and is devastated to find Antoni close to Bianca, who is holding Anita's personal love letter. Amidst a sudden thunderstorm, Bianca mocks Anita from afar and embraces Antoni, causing Anita to flee in tears. A flashback reveals that years prior, a science fair project built by Anita and Bianca malfunctioned and exploded in front of a laughing crowd, leading a humiliated Bianca to tear off her matching necklace and blame Anita for ruining her. In the present day, Bianca corners Anita in the school bathroom to confront her about the past. During the heated argument, Bianca admits her deep insecurity and resentment over the science fair disaster. Seeking closure, Anita offers Bianca the "B" necklace she has kept for years, but Bianca refuses it and walks out, leaving Anita alone with her reflection and unresolved tension.

results.title: Liv's Last Ride
results.overview: When an unexpected visitor disrupts a bachelorette party at a secluded cabin, the bridal party must bury old grudges and their shared dark history in order to survive the night.

results.title: Cut-Piece
results.overview: A story of power, conflict, and survival set in the underworld of Dhaka's garment waste trade.

results.title: Tonta que soy
results.overview: Between porn theaters, soda fountains in downtown Santiago, romantic movies and an episode of "Caso Cerrado", María Isabel tells her granddaughter a story from her youth about an impossible love affair with a married man.

results.title: SYDNEY CASH MAKES TOO MUCH ART
results.original_title: SYDNEY CASH MAKES TOO MUCH ART
results.overview: Sydney Cash is an 80-year-old artist who can’t stop making art. When space runs out and time grows short, his family faces an urgent decision about the fate of his life’s work. Turning the camera on his father’s artistic legacy, a son confronts how a lifetime of compulsive creating impacted their family.

results.title: 48/49 - Revolution in Baden.
results.overview: In September 1847, the people gathered at the “Salmen” inn in Offenburg and put forward 13 demands: freedom of the press, trial by jury, fair taxation and a parliament representing the people. What began as a protest became the revolution in Baden. In April 1848, Friedrich Hecker set out from Konstanz with a volunteer militia, in September Gustav Struve proclaimed the republic in Lörrach, and in May 1849 the Baden army went over to the people. Grand Duke Leopold fled and a provisional government took control of the country. Only Prussian troops brought the Baden Revolution to an end: on 23 July 1849, the fortress of Rastatt surrendered.

results.title: Brief glimpses of ahead
results.overview: I left the psychiatric hospital yesterday. I filmed myself in the shower of the CAPSUL 17 emergency unit. I felt the need to create something that would bear witness to the mixed-state episode I went through. This is the film made during my bipolar episode.

results.title: Catenaria
results.overview: Ángela has until 9.00 pm to get hold of the money she needs. In desperation, she scours the city in search of a solution, facing a reality that has rendered her invisible.

results.title: Big Time
results.overview: My partner kissed me on the lips and then got into a taxi headed towards the airport where he would get on a plane to Japan for a job that would keep him there for a minimum of two years. Before the taxi was out of sight I texted him, “We can do this, right?” to which he replied, “Big time.” Two days later I started punching holes into found 16mm film as a way to stay grounded. The resulting footage is a symbolic representation of the way I experience anxiety, which is primarily through repetitive, racing thoughts. The audio is a field recording from Shibuya Station, that my partner sent me on his way to work one morning, which felt like a love letter from him. This film is about long distance, communication, affection and also about working through being an anxiously attached adult as a result of living through an unstable childhood.

results.title: Fluss
results.overview: A journey down the Danube River is transformed into a dream space of half-seen images and flickering shorelines. Though at times abstract, the river remains certain, always moving towards the sea. Filmed in black and white 16mm and hand-processed, Fluss is a companion to River (2023), a study of the Ottawa River in winter. Commissioned by Ottawa’s Lightproof Film Collective.

results.title: En La Paz
results.overview: Created in-camera on a rooftop in La Paz, Bolivia in July on B&W reversal film with my Bolex as dusk was approaching. The city’s sea of antennas and surrounding mountains pointing to the sky inform the film’s sound.

results.title: Haavens
results.overview: A relationship fractures due to distance as shipments move in and out of the port of Rotterdam. On the days the port is closed, the vast area becomes a landscape used by other inhabitants. The film was hand processed and painted in Rotterdam, along with the process-related optical sound.

results.title: Medium Close
results.overview: Found footage from 1980s TV movies, camera tests and commercials is aligned with an invented narrative exploring conventions of cinema, love, relationships and their sometimes painful consequences. Cynicism and cliches along with love and regrets frame a narrative that is at once personal and every person.

results.title: novem
results.overview: novem is the ninth in a series of abstract poetic films made by the BIG TOP collective of Trace Nelson and Peter Sandmark. The film uses archival and found 16mm and 8mm footage along with original footage shot by the duo then hand painted and collaged in editing. The film has an original soundscape, using voices and various noise instruments, to add to the film’s sense of anxiety and disembodiment, as figures cartwheel through rock formations and cloud landscapes.

results.title: In Dreaming
results.overview: Ryan is destined to dance, but has to put his passion aside to fulfil his duties at his family’s nail salon.
